email.body1:
Jordan, saw Filevine launched LOIS and raised $400M to scale the AI legal platform.

In mid-market, that kind of momentum lights up more firms than the team can chase before the buzz fades, and the overflow is pipeline left on the table. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jordan, quick follow-up for Filevine.

Mid-market volume makes coverage the constraint, and most teams don't know how many meetings it takes to hit the number. So the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble while reps lose hours to research and CRM.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your mid-market team needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jordan, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other legal-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch right after a raise and a launch is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a mid-market motion? I'll tailor it to Filevine either way.
